content.comment_body: I located the upgrade for [product_name] V1.0 to V3.0 and V4.0, but the installer indicates there's no official version. I'm confident mine is official (purchased by the [company_name]). My current version is [company_name][product_name] V1.0 from 1996. I need assistance upgrading this version.

Updates for [product_name] are no longer available. The latest version V3.0.29 only supports older [product_name] modules with [article_no]. To work with newer modules, you need [product_name] Comfort. For the latest modules with [article_no], you must use [product_name] Comfort V4. There's no direct upgrade from [product_name] to [product_name] Comfort since these are completely different products. You can purchase [product_name] Comfort using order number: [article_no]. Best regards, [user_name], Technical Support [company_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users report considerable compatibility issues and lack of upgrade options when attempting to transition from earlier [product_name] software versions to newer releases. The move from [product_name] to [product_name] Comfort is unsupported by any upgrade pathway, resulting in confusion and preventing legacy users with official licenses from accessing current functionalities or newer hardware modules.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are seeking a simple and officially recognized upgrade from [product_name] V1.0 to newer versions or to [product_name] Comfort, ideally allowing their existing license and avoiding the need for a full repurchase.
